create_immutable_list: create an immutable list that raises NotImplementedError on mutation attempts
create_immutable_dict: create an immutable dict that raises NotImplementedError on mutation attempts
hash_immutable_list: hash an immutable list by converting it to a tuple and computing its hash
hash_immutable_dict: hash an immutable dict by converting its items to a tuple and computing its hash
register_pytree_immutable: register immutable_list and immutable_dict for pytree flatten and unflatten operations
